name: WINTER
summary: An independently named broadband experiment proposal testing photon–axion conversion in a vacuum interferometer arm inside a magnetic field.
detection_principle: A Mach–Zehnder interferometer senses amplitude changes caused by photon disappearance in its magnetic-field arm; polarization modulation extracts the signal and an optical cavity enhances it.

results.summary: The article presents a future apparatus design and projected sensitivity, without reporting particle-search results from a completed instrument.

science_scope: Produces and detects axions or dark-sector particles in the laboratory, rather than directly measuring Galactic-halo dark-matter flux. It tests interactions of dark-matter candidates; identifying a discovered particle as dark matter would also require establishing its cosmic abundance.
